title: GB MIR 7.2.1 rule book (84 blocks, five report types)
plain: The blocks the GB MIR requires in each report type, as a CSV rule book from MHRA's GB 7.2.1 files: the GB schemas' own minOccurs and MHRA's GB help text (a list of differences from the EU form), with the MDARIX GB form where it is stricter (B8-D6). Annex B, C, D and G codes are mandatory in every report type, with MHRA's fallback codes when none fits (B8-D3). Where the EU help text would be stricter and MHRA lists no difference, the row says so: to confirm.

source.clause: UK MDR 2002 Part 4A, as amended by SI 2024/1368

change.reason: B8 step 13: the GB MIR rules held as data from the start; the GB form's own must_in (forms.py) is checked against it.

review.note: Starter, for your consultant to confirm.

approval.note: B8 plan approved 11 Nov 2026 (B8-D3: Annex B-G on every GB type; B8-D6: the stricter of the XSD and the help text).
